description: Snapshot of a token's DEX pool liquidity now (DexScreener, deepest pair and every pair's USD liquidity). Stateless: pass the liquidityUsd you saved last time as previousLiquidityUsd and it returns the % change and a DROP/DRAIN flag. It keeps no history itself and does not show lock expiry dates. Choose this tool for: Snapshot of a token's DEX pool liquidity now. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_liquidity_lock_inspector (Share of a token's LP tokens that are burned or locked); agent_intel_wash_trading_volume_filter (Volume plausibility check for an EVM token's DEX pairs: 24h). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon or solana (default base)

previousLiquidityUsd.description: Optional: the deepest-pool liquidityUsd from your previous call
